Title: Шлемофон
Comment:
Вагоновожатые is how they spell it. Ukrainian EDM. Found these guys after reading an article that they (and others) had decided to give up playing in the Russian Langauge and from doing any gigs in Russian clubs after 2014. It wasn’t about the money to them.

Apparently, they started out as amateur musicians working for the public transportation in Ukraine and found a sampler and a microphone on one of the trains, so they started making electronic music.

Is it the best thing you’ve ever heard? Maybe not. But I appreciate them nonetheless. Slava Ukraine.
